title: TradingDay
description: Per-date calendar entry for an exchange: whether it is a trading day and, when it is not, why. The sessions of a trading day are assembled from the exchange session template; this model stays a pure per-date status record

date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date in Asia/Shanghai, e.g. 2026-08-13

exchange.description: Exchange this day entry applies to

isTradingDay.description: Whether the exchange trades on this date; weekends and holidays never count as trading days

reason.description: Optional reason when isTradingDay is false

note.description: Optional free-text note (e.g. holiday name or closure cause)
